description:
Discover the magic of La Luna, our enchanting geodesic dome, perfect for up to 4 guests. With thoughtful amenities and a unique blend of comfort and nature, your stay promises to be unforgettable.

Sleeping Arrangements:
	• Queen bed
	• Large U Shape Couch
	• Queen Folding Mattress
	• All essential linens provided

Outdoor Amenities:
	• Seating area
	• Firepit for cozy evenings under the stars
	• Propane grill for outdoor cooking 
	• Outdoor shower and sink


Private Facilities:
	• Private portable toilet

Conveniences:
	• One generator for powering lights, water pump, and electronic devices
	• Buddy heater 
        • Games


Important Notes:
	• Seasonal Considerations: The dome is not insulated, meaning summers can be very hot inside and winters extremely cold. Please pack accordingly to ensure your comfort during your stay.
	• Essentials: Bring your own drinking water and any additional items you may need to stay comfortable.

Book your celestial escape today and experience the perfect blend of comfort and adventure!
